acceptance-document.help: Write the acceptance document into docs/site/content/, read off tests/acceptance/**/*.feature.

bootstrap.help: Regenerate the checked-in kernel sources (Handles, the Java function registry) from src/firn/bootstrap's models.

compile.help: Compile every module and its test sources, all three levels.

docs.help: Write the generated pages, then build the website from them into build/website/.

extension.help: Package the VS Code extension into build/firn.vsix. Needs node on the host.

image.help: Build the container image from src/pkg/Dockerfile, for linux/amd64 only.

image-arm64.help: Build the container image for linux/arm64 only: the everyday build on an arm64 host.

image-fixture.help: Write build/system/broken-project, the unresolvable project `test image-model-error` mounts.

native.help: Build the static native firn binary.

release-image.help: Build the container image for every platform a release publishes (linux/amd64, and linux/arm64 under QEMU: about 46 min cold).

site.help: Render docs/site/ into build/website/ with Hugo, in its pinned container.

site-pages.help: Write docs/site/content/using/, one page per acceptance fixture.

toolchain.help: Build the toolchain image every other build step runs in.

devcontainer.help: Bring up the development container this repository describes.

devcontainer-only.help: Bring up the development container without building anything first.

open.help: Open the running development container in VS Code.

preflight.help: Check that docker answers and that /var/run/docker.sock exists, before anything builds.

up.help: Bring up the development container and open it in VS Code.

publish-extension.help: Publish build/firn.vsix to the Visual Studio Marketplace. Needs VSCE_PAT.

push-image.help: Push the image for every platform as one manifest list, and verify each platform is in the registry with the digest the build recorded (run `build release-image` first).

tag.help: Cut the release tag at HEAD and push it (`git push origin <tag>`, never `--tags`).

adr-index.help: Write docs/adr/README.md's table from the records' own Index: lines.

ci-arm64.help: Check that THIS host can build linux/arm64, and register the emulator if not (VM or LXC; needs root).

claude-plugins.help: Install the Claude Code plugins this repo is developed with, as declared in the manifest's `claude` section (#1286); idempotent, --dry-run previews.

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

font-table.help: Write LiberationSerif13.java from the Liberation Serif in the toolchain image.

install.help: Provision the host tooling the kernel needs - today oras; idempotent.

kernel-icons.help: Write src/firn/kernel/icons, the kernel's own class icons, from their generator.

toolchain-pin.help: Rewrite the toolchain block in this manifest, e.g. for a JDK bump.

workflows.help: Regenerate the product's GitHub workflows from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

workflows-check.help: Report drift between .github/workflows/ and this manifest, writing nothing.

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

acceptance.help: Run the acceptance level on its own: every scenario under tests/acceptance/.

all.help: Run the tests and the format check. The gate AGENTS.md requires.

baseline.help: One whole run per size over the D8 corpus, as docs/benchmarks.md records it.

bootstrap.help: Check that the generated kernel sources are what src/firn/bootstrap generates (adr/0079).

candidate-cost.help: What a reference field's candidate list costs over a 1M corpus (#346).

container.help: Run the shipped linux/amd64 container image over a bind-mounted project.

container-arm64.help: Run the shipped linux/arm64 image (under QEMU) over a bind-mounted project; the release runs it.

extension-tests.help: Run the VS Code extension's tests against the fake editor.

grammar.help: Run the editor's TextMate grammars through the engine VS Code runs them through.

image-model-error.help: Run the shipped linux/amd64 image over a project whose model does not resolve, and expect MODEL_ERROR (run `build image-fixture` first).

image-model-error-arm64.help: Run the shipped linux/arm64 image over a project whose model does not resolve, and expect MODEL_ERROR.

image-refuses.help: Run the shipped linux/amd64 image over a directory that is not a project, and expect its refusal.

image-refuses-arm64.help: Run the shipped linux/arm64 image over a directory that is not a project, and expect its refusal.

jmh.help: The JMH benchmarks for load, resolve, rules and generate.

model-format.help: Check every .firn in a project here for canonical form: `firn fmt --check`.

regression.help: Fail when a tracked number of docs/benchmarks.md is over 20 % worse (D10).

request-cost.help: What one LSP request spends its 16 s on, phase by phase over a 1M corpus (#306).

system.help: Run the system level on its own: the shipped binary, against tests/system/.

unit.help: Run the unit level on its own: src/test/unit/java/<module>. `--tests X` finds X in any module.

walk.help: Walk the acceptance scenarios with a person answering each step.
